lanes.name: PONS_PHASE_AWARE_EXACT_QUOTE
lanes.hypothesis: Same-block exact-integer sized curve buy/sell estimate outperforms marginal reserve proxy in predicting observed receipt amounts and false sellability.
lanes.baseline: Existing reserve-price proxy and original CurveSell/CurveBuy receipt.
lanes.falsifier: Independent native events disagree after justified fee/rounding or necessary source state is unrecoverable.
lanes.acceptance: New prospective source-bound or valid past event with exact block/source, sell quantity, phase/snipe/fees and negative tests; no retroactive alpha credit.

lanes.name: V4_POOL_HOOK_QUOTER
lanes.hypothesis: Native V4 quoter+hook fee and poolId improve postgraduation full-size exit assessment.
lanes.baseline: Reserve ratio and simple current pool depth.
lanes.falsifier: No verified ABI/pool-key/hook state, no reliable quote, or native V4 outputs no incremental accuracy.
lanes.acceptance: Exact chain+CA+poolId+block/hash plus both-way full-size source-only quote negative controls.

lanes.name: NEGATIVE_EXIT_LOCAL_FORK
lanes.hypothesis: Read-only local forks recover reproducible SELL reverts for cases where safety providers report SAFE.
lanes.baseline: Current GoPlus normalized label and Alpha mechanics ledger.
lanes.falsifier: Free archive state unavailable or simulated revert not reproducible given exact source block.
lanes.acceptance: At least one controlled original negative and benign control, no signing or broadcast, classified failure vs unknown.

lanes.name: ACTUAL_SWAP_RECEIPT_TRUTH
lanes.hypothesis: First-party receipt deltas quantify actual feasible execution and source discrepancies better than chart prices.
lanes.falsifier: No free permitted trace/transaction or cashflow attribution impossible for sampled source.
lanes.acceptance: Exact confirmed original actual executed tx and size/time wallet/token/quote movements with gas/tax and source coverage; buyer vs recipient separated.

lanes.name: SOURCE_CONTINUITY_AND_CAP
lanes.hypothesis: Source-specific log limits and gaps may censor eligibility and invalidate earliest clock even when provider responds 200.
lanes.baseline: Existing canonical Pons cursor and bounded public HOT/COLD source custody.
lanes.falsifier: Current collectors already source-attest complete windows or missing data cannot be recovered at zero added cost.
lanes.acceptance: Provider-specific cap=1000 (not universal) plus malicious 429/silent partial fixtures; contiguous windows, safe cursor and two natural source receipts where applicable.

lanes.name: SIZE_FX_AND_MINI_ROUTE
lanes.hypothesis: Same-block size-dependent route/fee and quote-currency-aware estimates are more useful than a single pair spot price.
lanes.baseline: Single-venue quote/marginal ratio and nominal USD assumption.
lanes.falsifier: Free source currency/route coverage missing or added calculation does not change qualified outcomes.
lanes.acceptance: Size ladder 50/100/250/500/1000 plus whole hypothetical position, USD as-of source or UNKNOWN and 25/50/80% sensitivity scenario.

lanes.name: PIT_EXECUTABLE_OUTCOME_ABLATION
lanes.hypothesis: Frozen Alpha strategies have different true net-after-cost outcomes from chart-only winners.
lanes.baseline: Four strategy families and eight frozen shadow arms, simple price/fixed liquidity benchmark.
lanes.falsifier: No matched eligible cohort, no original T0 source clock, no quote-at-decision or no improvement over cheapest baseline.
lanes.acceptance: Original immutable one-universe cohorts with nonentry/failed/censored rows; due 15m/1h/6h/24h/72h/7d without hindsight, positive/negative source coverage.

lanes.name: SITE_DATA_PRIVACY_AND_FRESHNESS
lanes.hypothesis: Private research outcomes can be projected to genuinely usable read-only near-live site instruments without leaking private sources or calling stale data LIVE.
lanes.baseline: Existing D2.5 private staging and static source-unavailable Trust Desk.
lanes.falsifier: No original public-safe approval, backend provenance or native Safari QA; source cadence slower than displayed label.
lanes.acceptance: Owner-approved allowlist-only privacy filter, tests for secret/wallet leakage, source time/TTL label, immutable frozen rows, private mobile UI preview and real source publish/Pages readback before LIVE.

lanes.name: CLAUDE_INDEPENDENT_RED_TEAM
lanes.hypothesis: Independent source-grounded adversarial review can find one material overlooked false SAFE, license, Pons graduation or website privacy/latency flaw.
lanes.baseline: Atlas plus current owner code/receipts with independent negative tests.
lanes.falsifier: No incremental reproducible finding or Claude queue priority blocks reading.
lanes.acceptance: One native claude/log report SHA with exact original source refs, reproducible fault or NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE; S1 independently adjudicates without fake approval.
